pass = every typed event ingested once, exactly the reference CONFLICT warnings posted once, a look-ahead at t in every turn, a summary every turn, "unavailable" said whenever the look-ahead answered so, no refused retries or re-posts, recovery after every injected fault. Scenarios: positive (feed on), no_feed, transient (first ledger_ingest fails), stale (first look-ahead forced unavailable).

record exact = all five fields match the scripted-scenario gold. accepted by runtime = the answer also passes venue/llm_fallback.py grounding on the transmission text. Fictional traffic, synthetic FAA JO 7110.65 phraseology; decision support only, the controller decides.
